messages:
Evelyn (CEO): Heads-up — all-hands next Wed 10:00 AM PT. Block is 45 minutes. Please read the note below and drop any questions here or in the doc.
Marta (Eng): Thanks — adding to calendar now. Can we include a short latency/perf snapshot in the runtime update?
Ken (Product): I can demo the new auto-rollout UI (5 min). Say 'I can' if you want a spot.
Devon (Design): Quick ask — can we keep 5–7 mins for community Qs? Those are high signal.
Ana (People Ops): Pre-read: https://drive.re/redwood/allhands-pre-read (contains remote-policy summary + hiring highlights). Please skim if you care about the policy section.
Evelyn (CEO): Agenda: 1) Exec recap (me) 2) Product demos (Ken + others) 3) Infra/runtime perf & SLOs (Marta) 4) Policy highlight: Updated remote-time policy (Ana) 5) Lightning talks (volunteers) 6) Live Q&A. Recording link + notes to follow.
Ken (Product): I'll be on for demo — will show canary rollout and rollback metrics.
Marta (Eng): Perf snapshot queued — will run a quick baseline before Wed and share slides.
Devon (Design): I'll take a 3-min 'console UX' lightning item if that's okay.
Ana (People Ops): Policy TL;DR in the doc: we encourage 2 overlapping core hours for team syncs but keep asynchronous-first default. Full doc at the link above.
Evelyn (CEO): If you have questions for the Q&A, post them below like: "Q: Will Dedicated support X?" or add to this doc: https://drive.re/redwood/allhands-questions
Ken (Product): Q: Are we deferring the Dedicated price change until Q4? (putting this in the doc too)
Marta (Eng): Q: Any change to SLO targets for inference in the new allocation plan?
Devon (Design): I can present the console mockups — reply 'I can' to grab a slot.
Teaser (infra-bot): CI check: perf-report v3 queued. Will attach summary when ready.
calendar-bot: Event created — All Hands — Wed 10:00 AM PT — Zoom link added.
Evelyn (CEO): Also: we're trying a short 'open mic' lightning track — 3–7 mins max. Volunteers: Ken, Devon, anyone else?
Ken (Product): I can confirm my slot. :thumbsup:
Devon (Design): I can — thanks!
Marta (Eng): +1 for the perf slide; will keep it to 4 slides.
Ana (People Ops): Reminder: if you want to propose a policy change item, ping me first so we can slot follow-up.
Evelyn (CEO): Thanks team. Please drop final questions by Tue EOD so we can batch answers in the notes.

--- (post-meeting follow-up) ---
Evelyn (CEO): Great all-hands — recording: https://zoom.re/redwood/rec/1789904000. Top takeaways: 1) Roadmap priorities clarified (plat infra, caching, UI rollouts). 2) New remote overlap policy adopted (see doc). 3) Dedicated pricing discussion deferred to leadership sync. 4) Canary rollout demo successful; auto-rollback enabled in prod. Notes + slides: https://drive.re/redwood/allhands-notes-1789904000
Marta (Eng): Perf highlights: median latency improved ~12% after KV cache tweak; 95p stable. Full perf report attached in notes.
Ken (Product): Demo artifacts and canary runbook in the product folder in the drive link.
Devon (Design): Uploaded the console mockups and a short video of the flow.
Ana (People Ops): Policy doc updated with 'core hours' language and examples. If it impacts your team, scheduler syncs with people-ops recommended.
Evelyn (CEO): Q&A summary: addressed Dedicated pricing timeline, SLO targets, and rollout cadence. If we missed your question, reply here and we'll follow up.
Marta (Eng): Thanks everyone. Small ops ask — infra will deploy the perf fix next Tue; will post in #eng-infra.
infra-bot: Noted — change window scheduled: Tue 02:00–03:00 PT. Will alert if any failures.
Ana (People Ops): Quick poll: did the meeting length feel right? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :hourglass_flowing_sand: for too long, :speech_balloon: if you want longer Q&A.
Evelyn (CEO): Appreciate the energy — short follow-up sync for execs to finalize Dedicated pricing decision later this week.
